page.layout: One printed page with running text in one column; running head at top; page number at top right; marginal note numbers "3" and "4" in the right margin beside the text; a fragment of a facing page with partial text in the left margin (not transcribed as it is the edge of the neighbouring page).

main_text.l: guinis ipsius, & si quid aliud in scripturis
Moysi leguntur. Vide eundem de doctr. Christ. lib. 3.
cap. 9. Hic enim distinguit servitutem ve-
teris populi, à jugo leni novi populi: & hoc
mentionem vero facit, non nisi duplicis
rum alterum esse dicimus id, de quo nunc
orum sit signum visibile, invisibilis gratiae:
enim libenter utimur celebri illo Irenaei loco
lib. 4. cap. 34. qui est a terra panis percipiens
panis est, sed Eucharistia, ex duabus rebus
3. Est vero panis & vinum ante & post
propterea enim duabus rebus constare dicitur

page.notes: Marginal numerals 3 and 4 beside the text are side note markers. Left margin fragments belong to the neighbouring page and are omitted. Several words are blurred and read with some doubt (e.g. "quinq;", "Moysi", "Prophetici"); the last line of the page is partly obscured.
